title: Coznt Choreography Frontmatter
description: YAML frontmatter contract for a CHOREOGRAPHY.md file pushed to a developer's repo. Matches Claude Code's native skill schema (name, description, optional allowed-tools) with coznt-specific extensions under the `coznt` namespace.

name.description: Human-facing name. Surfaces in Claude Code's skill picker.

description.description: Short description shown to the AI on every turn so it can decide whether to invoke. Include trigger language ('Use when...').

allowed-tools.description: Optional Claude-Code-style tool allowlist. Coznt does not enforce this; it's a hint for the host editor.

version.description: Semantic version of this choreography. Bump major on breaking workflow changes.

triggers.description: Free-form prose triggers describing when the AI should reach for this choreography. Read by the AI on session start.

required_verbs.description: MCP verbs this choreography references. Linter asserts each one exists in src/mcp/server.ts.

min_autonomy.description: Advisory minimum autonomy label (observe, propose, merge, lead). Server enforces ground truth; this is for the AI to self-check before invoking.
